# L0 policy status overrides / notes. Format: <ID> <STATUS|=> ;; note
GOV-015 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Git safety and git-workflow. Open related item: UNCERTAIN-L0-0001 — git-workflow permits destructive Git operations (reset --hard, clean, force push, branch deletion, rebasing shared history) "only when explicitly requested or clearly required by an approved workflow"; whether the second alternative widens GOV-015's "explicitly requested" condition is LINK_UNCERTAIN (see ORPHAN_SWEEP_REPORT.md).
API-019 = ;; Modality caveat: runtime-principles.md marks the liveness clause "(default)" (oracle MUST with 'should normally avoid'); readiness semantics are stated without qualifier; the health-check skill says a temporarily unavailable dependency "should not restart" the application.
WF-006 = ;; Modality caveat: verify, swagger and development-workflow state smoke verification with MUST strength (oracle DEFAULT).
WF-010 = ;; Enforcement note: the code-reviewer agent disallows Write, Edit and NotebookEdit; MultiEdit and shell tools are not disallowed, so read-only behaviour for those rests on the instruction text; check-instructions.mjs only verifies that Write and Edit are disallowed.
DEP-025 = ;; Enforcement note: the PreToolUse guard (fail-closed) blocks npm/pnpm/yarn --force/-f/--legacy-peer-deps (including npm_config_* assignments) with no approval-marker exception; an explicitly approved override must be run by the user (EXTRA); .npmrc bypass settings are flagged by the manifest check.
DEP-003 = ;; Enforcement note: the manifest check flags empty/'*' NuGet versions and '*'/'latest'/'x'/empty npm versions as floating and prerelease NuGet suffixes as allowed only when explicitly requested; version ranges are not detected.
ARC-001 = ;; Enforcement note: pre-bash blocks every dotnet reference add/remove command (EXTRA; approved changes are edited in the project file); the manifest check flags outward layer references and production→test references after edits/shell calls (non-blocking feedback); test projects are not reference-checked.
ARC-020 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Decision control; L0 adds further Reserved categories (reference-graph changes, search/external storage/external identity infrastructure, major libraries, project-wide conventions, adopting API versioning) and a LangVersion/target-framework Reserved rule in modern-csharp, recorded as EXTRA.
GOV-017 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Decision control defines Decided/Delegated/Reserved, the Reserved minimum list ('at least'), the five-question test, the Decision Request fields and headless handling (oracle-linked); L0 adds a vocabulary rule that deviations from a 'default' must be reported, recording of explicit-instruction approvals and accepted decisions in the two decision summaries, and an 'Accepted' section mechanism used by the manifest check (EXTRA).
GOV-018 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Challenge questionable requests requires naming the concrete concern and proposing an alternative before implementing, without silently rewriting the requirement; development-workflow requires raising concerns before writing code.
